name: forge
description: Root manifest for Netlify Functions dependency installation. The Forge plugin itself is not a Node project — this file exists so Netlify's build system installs the resend dependency for netlify/functions/submission-created.js. Per Netlify's recommendation (https://docs.netlify.com/functions/dependencies/), function dependencies live in the project's top-level package.json, not in a per-function package.json.
